//: This workspace holds 487,065 files across 61,935 directories — data/ alone is 422,228. Windows needs one ReadDirectoryChangesW handle per watched directory, so with no excludes the editor's extension host sat at ~97% of a core with 300k+ syscalls per second and zero bytes read: a watcher spinning over tens of thousands of directories it has no reason to watch. Nothing excluded here is source.
//files.exclude: Deliberately minimal. Hiding directories from the tree makes them hard to inspect when something breaks, and the CPU problem was the watcher, not the tree.
